meta.description: Effect glossary for PMTU moves. moves.json 'effects' codes resolve via 'codes' to one or more ids in 'effects'.
meta.thresholdRule: A code ending in a number is rolled on the Effect Die; the effect triggers only if the result is at least that number. A threshold of 1 always triggers (requiresRoll=false). Threshold null means no roll.
meta.dieField: Each move has 'die' (d4, d6, d8). 'die_alt' means the die changes to die_alt.die if the Effect Die result is at least die_alt.effect_die_min. d4 / d8 / d4_conditional entries describe these.
meta.icon: Placeholder for each effect's icon image (null until filled in). A code with 'iconOverride' (advdis6, which uses a custom combined graphic) should use that instead of its effects' icons when set.

adv.name: Advantage
adv.description: The user rolls 1 extra Attack Die and discards the lowest result.

doubadv.name: Double Advantage
doubadv.description: The user rolls 2 extra Attack Dice and discards the two lowest results.

add.name: Add Die
add.description: The user rolls an extra Attack Die and the results are added together.

rage.name: Enraged
rage.description: The user gains Advantage for this Battle Round if the opponent's selected Move has an Attack Strength greater than 0.

d4.name: D4
d4.description: This Move uses a d4 for its Attack Roll.

d8.name: High Crit (D8)
d8.description: This Move uses a High Crit d8 for its Attack Roll. Treat a 7 as a 5 and an 8 as a 6.

life.name: Life Recovery
life.description: Add 1/3 of the user’s Attack Roll (rounded down) to the Attack Total.

ko_self.name: K.O. (Self)
ko_self.description: The user Faints at the end of the Battle Round.

switch_self.name: Switchout (Self)
switch_self.description: After applying the opponent's Move Effects, the user is switched out of Battle and replaced with another from its team. The switched-in Pokémon uses this Move for this Battle Round. This effect does not apply to wild Pokémon or a Gym Leader's Pokémon.

conf_self.name: Confusion (Self)
conf_self.description: The user gains the Confused Status Condition.

halflevel_self.name: 1/2 Level (Self)
halflevel_self.description: The Attack Strength of this Move is equal to half of the user's Level (rounded down).

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Any effects used by the opponent's Pokémon that target the user are ignored until the end of the Battle Round. (No effect if the opponent has Protection.)

statdown.name: Stat Down
statdown.description: Beginning on the next Battle Round, the user gains Disadvantage until the end of the Battle (or until it is switched out).

ignore.name: Ignore Type
ignore.description: Do not apply any Type Effectiveness bonuses or penalties to this Move.

recharge.name: Recharge
recharge.description: Once used, the user cannot select this Move for the rest of the Battle or until the user is switched out.

prot.name: Protection
prot.description: During this Battle Round, the Attack Strength of the opponent's Move becomes 0 and all Move Effects that target the user are ignored.

reversal.name: Reversal
reversal.description: The user adds the Attack Strength of the opponent’s selected Move to this Move.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: The Attack Strength of this Move increases by 1 for each successive Battle Round it has been used in this Battle, to a maximum of 3.

boost.name: Condition Boost
boost.description: This Move gains 1 Attack Strength this Battle Round if opponent's Pokémon has a Status Condition when you make your Attack Roll.

revival.name: Revival
revival.description: Revive a Pokémon on the user's team immediately after the Effect Die would be rolled. Only one Pokémon per Battle, per team can be revived this way.

status.name: Status Heal
status.description: Roll a d4 and remove up to that number of Status Conditions from Pokémon on the user's team immediately after the Effect Die would be rolled.

dis.name: Disadvantage
dis.description: The opponent rolls 1 extra Attack Die and discards the highest result.

doubdis.name: Double Disadvantage
doubdis.description: The opponent rolls 2 extra Attack Dice and discards the 2 highest results.

ko_opp.name: K.O. (Opponent)
ko_opp.description: The opponent Pokémon Faints at the end of the Battle Round.

switch_opp.name: Switchout (Opponent)
switch_opp.description: Before applying their Move Effects, the opponent's Pokémon is switched out of Battle and replaced with another from its team, chosen randomly. The switched-in Pokémon then selects a Move to use. This effect does not apply to wild Pokémon, a Gym Leader's Pokémon, or Pokémon under the effect of Priority or Protection.

conf_opp.name: Confusion (Opponent)
conf_opp.description: The opponent's Pokémon gains the Confused Status Condition.

halflevel_opp.name: 1/2 Level (Opponent)
halflevel_opp.description: The Attack Strength of this Move is equal to half of the opponent Pokémon's Level (rounded down).

blockitem.name: Block Item
blockitem.description: The opponent's Pokémon cannot make use of their Attach Card for the remainder of the Battle or until they are switched out.

lock.name: Escape Prevention
lock.description: For the rest of the Battle, the opponent's Pokémon cannot be switched out.

burn.name: Burn
burn.description: The opponent's Pokémon gains the Burned Status Condition.

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.description: The opponent's Pokémon gains the Frozen Status Condition.

pois.name: Poison
pois.description: The opponent's Pokémon gains the Poisoned Status Condition.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.description: The opponent's Pokémon gains the Sleep Status Condition.

curse.name: Curse
curse.description: The opponent's Pokémon gains the Cursed Status Condition.

para.name: Paralyze
para.description: The opponent's Pokémon gains the Paralyzed Status Condition.

field_clear.name: Field Clear
field_clear.description: After the Effect Die would be rolled this Battle Round, discard all Field Move cards from play.

electric_terrain.name: Electric Terrain
electric_terrain.description: Play the Electric Terrain Field Move card.

grassy_terrain.name: Grassy Terrain
grassy_terrain.description: Play the Grassy Terrain Field Move card.

misty_terrain.name: Misty Terrain
misty_terrain.description: Play the Misty Terrain Field Move card.

psychic_terrain.name: Psychic Terrain
psychic_terrain.description: Play the Psychic Terrain Field Move card.

rain.name: Rain
rain.description: Play the Rain Field Move card.

harsh_sunlight.name: Harsh Sunlight
harsh_sunlight.description: Play the Harsh Sunlight Field Move card.

hail.name: Hail
hail.description: Play the Hail Field Move card.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.description: Play the Sandstorm Field Move card.

mist.name: Mist
mist.description: Play the Mist Field Move card.

renewal.name: Renewal
renewal.description: Play the Renewal Field Move card.

safeguard.name: Safeguard
safeguard.description: Play the Safeguard Field Move card.

spikes.name: Spikes
spikes.description: Play the Spikes Field Move card.

toxic_spikes.name: Toxic Spikes
toxic_spikes.description: Play the Toxic Spikes Field Move card.

stealth_rock.name: Stealth Rock
stealth_rock.description: Play the Stealth Rock Field Move card.

d4_conditional.name: D4 (on Effect Die)
d4_conditional.description: If the result of the Effect Die Roll is at least the number shown, the Move's die becomes a d4.

extra_self.name: Roll Effect Die Again (Self)
extra_self.description: Roll the Effect Die again. See this Move's entry under Special Move Effects for the result.

extra_opp.name: Roll Effect Die Again (Opponent)
extra_opp.description: Roll the Effect Die again. See this Move's entry under Special Move Effects for the result.
